newsitem.title: JAPAN: All Tokyo corn futures end down on lower Chicago.
newsitem.headline: All Tokyo corn futures end down on lower Chicago.

text.p: All Tokyo corn futures ended lower on Thursday, reflecting a weaker Chicago market overnight and the yen's gains against the dollar, traders said.
Prices were 60 to 250 yen lower, with the benchmark March 1998 contract down 120 yen at 16,000 yen per tonne. The day's volume was 71,121 lots.
Active selling by local investors emerged from the opening, particularly of distant months, traders said.
On the CBOT Project A overnight trading system, most-active March corn futures traded at $2.93 per bushel as of 0845 GMT, up from $2.92-3/4 at Wednesday's close.
CBOT Project A March soybeans stood at $7.85-3/4 per bushel, compared with $7.83-3/4 on Wednesday.
